rollback_gate.name: coordinated_activation_rollback_gate
conditions: keep managed_runtime_coordinated_cutover disabled in every shipped profile
preserve the recorded downgrade_floor until the qualification report is accepted
rollback activation before any schema downgrade

crash_windows.window: after claim commit and before provider inspect/cancel
crash_windows.expected_recovery: reuse the operation claim and perform at most one accepted provider effect

crash_windows.window: after PREPARED commit and before provider dispatch
crash_windows.expected_recovery: replay the immutable assignment without creating a second execution

crash_windows.window: after DISPATCHING commit and before provider invocation
crash_windows.expected_recovery: recover as crossed/unknown and never authorize a blind redispatch

crash_windows.window: provider accepted the operation but the response was lost before receipt persistence
crash_windows.expected_recovery: retry with the same operation id and persist one canonical receipt

crash_windows.window: after terminal evidence is observed and before the convergence transaction commits
crash_windows.expected_recovery: replay the same terminal observation idempotently with no duplicate business effects

crash_windows.window: between deadline claim and aggregate finalization
crash_windows.expected_recovery: stale or duplicate finalization fails closed; one terminal or unknown conclusion remains
